description: This file contains the kernel swapper implementation for the IA-32 architecture, including context switch routines, floating point state handling, and thread entry adjustments.

methods.name: arch_swap
methods.description: Performs a context switch by saving and restoring CPU registers, handling floating point state, and updating thread states during a cooperative or preemptive switch.

methods.name: z_x86_thread_entry_wrapper
methods.description: Adjusts the thread's initial stack frame to make it recognizable by GDB for unwinding, by zeroing out the initial EFLAGS.
